Will not our martyrs go to Jannah while their dead will go to Jahannam?" "Certainly," Rasulullaah ﷺ replied. "Then why should we compromise our Deen?" Umar (RA) asked, "Why should we return when Allaah has not yet decided between us and the Mushrikeen?" Rasulullaah ﷺ reassured him saying, "O son of Khattaab! I am the Rasul of Allaah and Allaah shall never ever lead me to destruction."
Hadhrat Umar (RA) was still upset when he went away. He proceeded straight to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and asked, "O Abu Bakr! Are we not on the truth and the Mushrikeen on falsehood?" "O son of Khattaab!" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "He is the Rasul of Allaah and Allaah shall never ever lead him to destruction." It was after this that Allaah revealed Surah Fatah.[^1]

Another narration states that Hadhrat Sahl bin Hunayf (RA) said, "O people! You have only your own opinions to blame! I have seen myself on the day of Abu Jandal (when Rasulullaah ﷺ was forced to hand him over to the Mushrikeen according to the demands of the treaty). Had I the ability to reverse this decision of Rasulullaah ﷺ, I would have certainly done so (but no one's Imaan would allow him to oppose a decision coming from Rasulullaah ﷺ). Yet another narration adds that when Surah Fatah was revealed, Rasulullaah ﷺ sent for Hadhrat Umar (RA) and recited it to him.[^2]

In the chapter concerning Da'wah towards Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ (Chapter one) and under the discussion of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, the narration of Hadhrat Miswar bin Makhramah (RA) has already been quoted. The narration states that Hadhrat Abu Jandal (RA) addressed the Muslims saying, "O gathering of Muslim! Why should I be returned to the Mushrikeen when I have come as a Muslim? Have you not seen how I have suffered?" Hadhrat Abu Jandal (RA) had endured severe torture at the hands of the Mushrikeen.
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "Are you not the true Nabi of Allaah?" "I am indeed," replied Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked further, "Are we not on the truth and our enemies on falsehood?" "Certainly," said Rasulullaah ﷺ. "Then," asked Hadhrat Umar (RA), "why do we have to submit?" Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "I am certainly the Rasool of Allaah. I cannot disobey Him and He is my Helper." Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Did you not tell us that we shall arrive at the Kabah and perform Tawaaf around it?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Indeed I did but did I tell you that it would be this year?" "No," said Hadhrat Umar (RA). "Then you shall certainly arrive there and perform Tawaaf around it," Rasulullaah ﷺ assured him.
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then approached Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and asked him, "Is he not the true Nabi of Allaah?" "He is indeed," replied Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked further, "Are we not on the truth and our enemies on falsehood?" "Certainly," said Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). "Then," asked
